evals.prompt: 我在做一款 2D RPG,需要一首新手村的循環 BGM,大概 90 秒,要能無縫循環,輸出 ogg 給 Godot 用。
evals.expected_output: Plans with style rpg-town (or similar), game-bgm workflow, loop-friendly caption (steady, repetitive, no intro/outro), generates variants, runs postprocess with loop + loudnorm, exports ogg, reports the QC seam line and states the loop is crossfade-based.
assertions: Uses msconfig.py plan and engine.py generate rather than inventing parameters
Caption is English and contains steady/repetitive and no build/outro words
Runs the loop step and exports ogg
Reports QC / seam result in plain words and offers the loop preview
Does not claim the BPM or loop is guaranteed

evals.prompt: 以後我的預設都用 high 品質,而且響度目標改成 -14 LUFS。
evals.expected_output: Writes the two keys to the workspace config via msconfig.py set, validates, tells the user what changed and how to revert; does not touch defaults/.
assertions: Runs msconfig.py set quality.default high and postprocess.loudness_lufs -14
Runs validate
Does not edit files under defaults/
Mentions unset as the way to revert

evals.prompt: 幫我做一段 42 秒的短片配樂,前面平靜,後面慢慢升起情緒,結尾要自然收掉。沒有 GPU 先讓我看看流程。
evals.expected_output: Uses the video-score workflow with duration 42 and the mock engine, describes the arc in the caption, warns that mock audio is a synthetic test signal, fit step makes it exactly 42 s with a fade-out.
assertions: Uses --engine mock or config engine mock and says the audio is a test signal
Duration is exactly 42 in the spec and the final file length is about 42 s
Caption describes the arc (calm then building)
Does not promise that the build hits a specific second

evals.prompt: 我想做一個新的風格叫「雨夜咖啡廳」,爵士鋼琴加雨聲,慢節奏,之後常用。
evals.expected_output: Creates a user style file in the workspace styles folder (or via the dashboard) with English caption tags, bpm range, keys and duration, validates it, and generates or offers a sample.
assertions: Style file is created in the workspace, not in the skill's defaults/
Caption tags are English and concrete (instruments, texture)
msconfig.py validate passes
Style appears in msconfig.py styles

evals.prompt: 我生成的時候一直出現 oom,怎麼辦?我的卡是 8GB。
evals.expected_output: Runs engine.py check, explains tier mid, suggests draft quality / shorter length / lower max_batch / closing GPU apps, mentions the automatic retry with one variant, points to troubleshooting.
assertions: Runs or references engine.py check
Mentions the automatic batch-1 retry
Suggests concrete settings with the exact config keys
Does not suggest editing anything inside defaults/

evals.prompt: 幫我做一首有主唱的中文流行歌。
evals.expected_output: Says vocals are phase 2 and not built yet, points to roadmap, offers an instrumental backing track in the meantime.
assertions: States plainly that vocal songs are not supported yet
Offers instrumental alternative
Does not fabricate lyrics generation through the engine

evals.prompt: 我用 8GB 顯卡,生出來的音樂雜訊很多,而且不太像我描述的『下雨天讀書的鋼琴爵士』。
evals.expected_output: Reads quality.md, runs engine.py check, inspects the last take's effective/warnings, finds causes (quantization/no LM/long duration/description not in caption), fixes config via msconfig.py set in the workspace, regenerates with the same seed and shows the caption preview.
assertions: Looks at the take's effective settings or engine.py check instead of guessing
Identifies at least one concrete cause and changes a workspace setting
Writes an English caption that includes rain, piano and jazz tags
Keeps the duration within 30-120 s
Does not edit defaults/

evals.prompt: 幫我做一首咖啡廳的輕鬆爵士背景音樂,越快越好。
evals.expected_output: Plans without asking questions, starts the dashboard in the background and gives the URL (or tells the user to double-click start_dashboard.bat), generates with draft/standard, reports progress in short lines.
assertions: Asks no more than one question
Provides the dashboard URL or the start_dashboard.bat instruction
Caption is English with jazz, piano and cafe-like tags
Reports the result with a next step (pick, refine or finalize)
